title: Hormuz shipping reported 65% below pre-war levels in mid-November
detail: UKMTO, as reported by a Google News-aggregated outlet, says Strait of Hormuz shipping was about 65% below pre-war levels in mid-November. Single aggregated report; the original article was not retrieved and the figure is not independently verified. Depressed transits sustain freight, insurance and food/fertiliser import cost risks.

title: Two ships hit near Oman in Hormuz; Iran says vessel caught fire after mine strike
detail: A Google News-aggregated report says two ships were hit near Oman in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran says one vessel caught fire after a mine strike. Single aggregated report; the original article was not retrieved and details are not independently verified. Further attacks sustain freight, insurance and food/fertiliser import cost risks.
